visualCharacteristics.purpose: Two-column intro band: large heading and link on the left, body text on the right
visualCharacteristics.description: Light-blue band (rgb 212,223,241). Left: blue uppercase condensed h2 + "TERNA IN BREVE >" link; right: two blue paragraphs.

contentPattern.summary: Two-column intro: large heading + link left, body paragraphs right, on a colored band.
contentPattern.structure: one row, two cells. The cell holding the heading is the lead column (placed first); the other cell holds body paragraphs. Link-only paragraphs are marked as CTAs. Place it in a section with a style (e.g. light-blue) for the colored band
contentPattern.sourceContent: Heading + link on the left, two paragraphs on the right

usage: Homepage "Siamo dietro l'energia che usi ogni giorno" intro on a light-blue band.
reuseGuidance: Use for heading-left / text-right introductions. For three or more tiles use columns-tiles.
